stopping_rules: stop before compute on admission refusal
stop on contamination refusal (KNOWN/POSSIBLE on any declared source)
stop on campaign settlement overrun (artifact preserved)
never enlarge a frozen threshold after candidate results are visible
notes: Identity is two objects, never one overloaded field: the dense base (content digest 59e767aa…, Generation 0) and the gen1 adapter (ca8769c5…) applied over it, which parent_version=gen1 names. 'parent_model_digest' is deliberately gone: it used to mean the base in prose and the adapter in the file. Parent evidence state: gen1 effective verdict INCONCLUSIVE with target_repair_validated=true (docs/growth/GEN1_READJUDICATION_ADDENDUM_2026-09-17.md). Gen2's protected gates are candidate-measured via the frozen 16-item mini-slices; no carried evidence satisfies any gate. device_time_measured=false per GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT1_2026-09-18: the trainer reports wall time, so device ceilings are admission (projected-plan) constraints and wall is the post-run settlement gate. baseline_eval_report_path is the trusted-ancestor (gen0) arm declared by GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT2_2026-09-18: a fresh 16-item mini-slice measurement on the untouched dense gen0 parent, MEASURED_PARENT rows, referenced at zero incremental cost, which the runner copies to <state_root>/baseline_evaluation.json for the judge's T16 branch-protection gate. It is not the 2026-09-16 gen0 freeze report (different protocol) and not the gen1 parent arm. Prereg: docs/quals/GEN2_PREREG_2026-09-17.md; amendments: docs/quals/GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT1_2026-09-18.md, docs/quals/GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT2_2026-09-18.md; judge: docs/gen2/judge_gen2.py. Run readiness (2026-09-18, GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT5): the candidate arm is a run output -- 'candidate_eval_report_path' is retired and a run must be given an evaluation seam that measures the artifact it selected -- and this declaration provides none of the six inputs run_campaign reads from disk as an existing artifact. Four have no parked file anywhere (project_template_path, training_material_path, data_registry_path, hardware_budget_path: the Gen-1 driver composed them in process), parent_profile_path has no Gen-1 measurement (the Gen-0 freeze profile is not the Gen-1 profile), the contamination manifest is produced by the run into its own state root, and the Gen-0 baseline arm is declared but not yet measured. Both 'chowder growth campaign plan' and '... run' therefore refuse before compute, naming every undeclared input at once. Amendment 6 (GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT6_2026-09-18) supplies the instrument that amendment 5 said was missing: the production candidate evaluator (chowder.growth.evaluation_binding.SubprocessEvaluationFn) now measures the selected adapter through the real transformers-text worker, and the run phase requires a seventh declared input, 'evaluation_material_path', naming the dataset and scoring for each declared benchmark. That file does not exist yet, so it joins the undeclared list below; the target instrument's diagnostic metadata (the judge's T1-T10) still lives only in the historical Gen-1 driver. That is the honest state of this declaration: no path is invented here to make it look runnable, and producing those documents from production code plus measuring the Gen-0 arm is the remaining pre-compute build (docs/HANDOFF.md, docs/ROADMAP.md). GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT14_2026-10-04 (the declared-inputs amendment, following AMENDMENT13 of 2026-09-18; this supersedes the earlier 'AMENDMENT7_2026-10-04' tag in this same field, which collided with AMENDMENT7_2026-09-18): the preregistered protection is now declared mechanically -- retention_profile (max-regression on math500@2024-04 and mgsm@2022-11, permitting a dip of one 16th of a 16-item mini-slice, which is what protection.slice_regression_max=0.0625 already allowed) and eval_tier_policy (both protected benchmarks are promotion-evidence, so no search-readable or carried evidence can satisfy a gate); the loader refuses malformed declarations at load and both promotion paths enforce them per cycle, and this adds no threshold the prereg did not already state in protection.slice_regression_max. The same amendment declares what production then produced, so the run phase no longer has an undeclared input: 'chowder growth campaign prepare docs/gen2/gen2_campaign.json --out-dir <state_root>/prepared-v10 --parent-evidence <gen1 durable run root> --parent-measurement <state_root>/prepared-v9/parent-eval-report.json' wrote project-template, training-material, data-registry, hardware-budget, evaluation-material, contamination, parent-profile and parent-eval-report into one directory, and the declaration names those paths plus the planner's own proposed recipe ids (recipe-00-lr5e-05, recipe-01-lr0.0001) rather than the placeholders gen2-recipe-a/-b, which the planner never proposed. Evidence, not invention: hardware-budget is a real CUDA device probe on this machine (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti, bounded synthetic step timings); the two protected slices are the pinned HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500 and juletxara/mgsm caches read offline; the parent arm is the preserved Gen-1 measurement of 2026-09-19 carried forward unchanged (three MEASURED_PARENT gen1 rows: generation-diagnostics@gen2-response-surface-v1 0.5625, math500@2024-04 0.0, mgsm@2022-11 0.0, same artifact and slice digests as the preserved report), not a re-measurement and not a carried-forward quote; parent-profile is build_skill_profile over exactly those rows. 'chowder growth campaign readiness' on this declaration reports READY with every one of its seventeen checks ok and no reason code (2026-10-04, 321 s, of which most is the base model-content digest over ten payload files). What is still true and unchanged: no Gen-2 candidate evaluation exists, the target instrument's diagnostic metadata (the judge's T1-T10) lives only in the historical Gen-1 driver, and starting the run itself remains a separate decision. GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT15_2026-10-04 (the declared-gate coupling): the retention_profile value is SIGNED, and amendment 14 wrote it with the wrong sign. A max-regression constraint's value is the minimum acceptable candidate-vs-parent delta, so a permitted dip is declared negative (tests/test_growth_eval_tiers_retention_paired.py::test_small_declared_dip_within_budget_passes pins that with -0.02); amendment 14 wrote +0.0625, which requires the candidate to IMPROVE by one sixteenth of a mini-slice on both protected benchmarks rather than permitting a one-sixteenth regression -- a stricter gate than the frozen protection.slice_regression_max=0.0625 it claims to state, and one that would have rejected a candidate the frozen branch-protection rule accepts. Both constraints are therefore -0.0625, exactly -(protection.slice_regression_max), and the invariant is now pinned by a test against this declaration (tests/test_growth_campaign_runner.py::test_the_declared_retention_profile_states_the_frozen_tolerance_with_the_right_sign). The same amendment couples the frozen judge to the run's decision: T21 audits the record the run writes (campaign-run.json) and T22 recomputes this profile through production's own evaluate_retention and compares the two answers, so the judge can no longer certify a candidate the run refused. No Gen-2 candidate evaluation exists, so no threshold moves after results are visible; the number itself is unchanged from what the prereg froze. GEN2_PREREG_AMENDMENT16_2026-10-04 (the settlement artifact pin): the judge settled the accounting artifact it read (T13) but never checked that the artifact was the one the run settled, and T21 collected only declared-gate reasons, so a run REFUSED on its own frozen envelope was PASSed by T21 while T13 recomputed compliance from whatever bytes were in the run root. Measured on a real run_campaign root: the run records REJECTED with ACTUAL_WALL_GPU_HOURS_EXCEEDED (0.5120 wall against the declared 0.2000 ceiling of this amendment-1 envelope), and editing one file -- cycle_compute_accounting.json -- made the frozen judge return PROMOTED with every row PASSing over a record that still said REJECTED. The anchor already existed and was unread: CampaignRun.cost['accounting_digest'] is the ledger digest CycleCostLedger.write stamps, so T23 now recomputes that digest through production's ledger_digest and requires the artifact's own settlement to agree with the record's recorded one; an absent pin, absent settlement, unreadable artifact or unreadable campaign is UNKNOWN, a moved artifact or a disagreement is FAIL, and no threshold moves. The write-to-pin-to-judge path is asserted end to end (tests/test_growth_settlement_adversarial.py), and both revert proofs were measured: with the gate unwired the attack certifies, and with only the digest clause disabled the agreement clause refuses the same root.
